title: CERN Open Data Terms of Use
evidence: The CERN Open Data Portal terms state that metadata and datasets are made available under CC0 waiver terms.
The terms state that content is provided as-is and users should review applicable license conditions for non-dataset content.

title: CMS NanoAOD Getting Started
evidence: CMS NanoAOD datasets can be analysed with common ROOT and Python workflows.
NanoAOD analysis does not require CMSSW for the analysis stage.
The guide references XRootD access patterns and cernopendata-client usage in practical workflows.

title: Running CMS analysis code using Docker
evidence: The CMS Docker guide recommends cms-cloud container images for local analysis workflows.
The guide documents container startup patterns exposing VNC and notebook ports for analysis sessions.

title: cernopendata-client documentation
evidence: The cernopendata-client command set includes get-metadata, get-file-locations, and download-files.
The client supports selecting records by recid or DOI and supports xrootd protocol access.
download-files supports deterministic filter-range selection for bounded subsets.
